name: Artillerist Spells
description:
When you reach an Artificer level specified in the Artillerist Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Level 3: Shield, Thunderwave

Level 5: Scorching Ray, Shatter

Level 9: Fireball, Wind Wall

Level 13: Ice Storm, Wall of Fire

Level 17: Cone of Cold, Wall of Force
